card.text: Pandora's Cluster: several clusters of galaxies coming together, 1.26 billion parsecs away.

introduction.text: Webb's near-infrared view. The red arcs are far galaxies magnified and stretched by the cluster's gravity; the picture is flat and has no depth.

sources.label: ESA/Webb weic2305a: NASA, ESA, CSA, I. Labbe (Swinburne University of Technology), R. Bezanson (University of Pittsburgh), A. Pagan (STScI)
sources.locator: caption: these lensed sources appear red in the image, and often as elongated arcs distorted by the gravitational lens

optical.title: Pandora's Cluster in near infrared
optical.summary: Webb's near-infrared view of the merging clusters and the far galaxies they magnify. A flat picture of the sky; no depth.
